description: This file provides utilities for setting up and managing OpenTelemetry tracing in a Kubernetes component, including creating tracer providers, adding tracing to HTTP handlers, and propagator configuration.

classes.name: TracerProvider
classes.description: Interface extending oteltrace.TracerProvider with a Shutdown method.

classes.name: noopTracerProvider
classes.description: Implementation of TracerProvider that does nothing on shutdown.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Method to shut down the tracer provider, implemented by noopTracerProvider.

methods.name: NewNoopTracerProvider
methods.description: Creates a tracer provider that performs no tracing.

methods.name: NewProvider
methods.description: Creates and configures a new OpenTelemetry tracer provider based on the given tracing configuration.

methods.name: WithTracing
methods.description: Wraps an HTTP handler to add tracing capabilities.

methods.name: WrapperFor
methods.description: Returns a transport wrapper function to add tracing to HTTP clients.

methods.name: Propagators
methods.description: Returns the default set of context propagators for tracing.
